info.name: Model-Mgmt API Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Tazama Model Management Backend organized by service modules.

## Authentication
All requests require a Bearer token obtained from your authentication provider (Keycloak).

## Required Claims
- **GET operations**: `editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`
- **POST/CREATE operations**: `editor`
- **PUT/UPDATE operations**: `editor`

## Base URL
Update the `{{baseUrl}}` variable with your Model-management backend URL (default: `http://localhost:3000`)

item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Authenticate user and obtain JWT token.

### Request Body
- **username**: User login name
- **password**: User password

### Response
- **token**: JWT access token
- **message**: Success message
- **expiresIn**: Token expiration time (optional)

### Use Case
Required for all subsequent API calls. Token is automatically saved to environment variable.

item.name: Nodes

request.description:
Creates one or more new nodes in the system.

### Request Body
Array of node objects with required fields:
- **id**: Unique node identifier
- **type**: Node type classification
- **name**: Human-readable node name
- **description**: Node description
- **config**: Node configuration object

### Required Claims
`editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`

Retrieves all nodes with optional query parameters for filtering.

### Query Parameters
- **limit**: Maximum number of nodes to return
- **offset**: Starting position for pagination
- Additional filtering parameters supported

### Required Claims
`editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`

query.description: ID of the node to delete

request.description:
Deletes a specific node by its ID.

### Path Parameters
- **nodeId**: ID of the node to delete

### Query Parameters
- **nodeId**: Node ID (also required as query parameter)

### Response
Success/failure message with operation status

### Required Claims
`editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`

item.description: Node management endpoints for creating, retrieving, and deleting system nodes.

item.name: Parse & Extract

request.description:
Validates and processes ISO 20022 transactional message payloads.

### Request Body
- **TxTp**: Transaction type (e.g., "pain.001.001.11")
- **Message payload**: Complete ISO 20022 message structure

### Response
Validation result with parsed data and any validation errors

### Required Claims
`editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`

### Use Case
Validates transaction message structure and extracts relevant data for processing.

item.description: Parse and extract service for processing ISO 20022 transactional messages.

item.name: Rules Management

request.description:
Retrieves available rule statuses based on user role.

### Response
Array of status strings available to the user's role

### Required Claims
`editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`

Retrieves paginated list of rules with optional filters.

### Query Parameters
- **offset**: Starting position (0-based index)
- **limit**: Number of records per page

### Request Body (Optional Filters)
- **status**: Filter by rule status
- **txtp**: Filter by transaction type
- **publishing_status**: Filter by publishing status
- **rule_id**: Search by rule ID
- **rule_name**: Search by rule name

### Required Claims
`editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`

Retrieves all available rule IDs.

### Response
Array of rule ID objects

### Required Claims
`editor`, `approver`, or `publisher`

body.raw:
{
    "rule_id": "high-value-transfer-001",
    "rule_name": "High Value Transfer Detection",
    "description": "Detects payment transfers exceeding $10,000 for fraud prevention",
    "txtp": "pain.001.001.11",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "rule_type": "fraud_detection",
    "rule_config_id": "CFG001",
    "status": "ACTIVE",
    "publishing_status": "DRAFT"

request.description:
Creates a new transaction rule.

### Required Fields
- **rule_id**: Unique identifier (alphanumeric with hyphens)
- **rule_name**: Human-readable name
- **description**: Detailed description
- **txtp**: Transaction type (e.g., "pain.001.001.11")
- **version**: Semantic version (e.g., "1.0.0")
- **rule_type**: Classification (fraud_detection, aml, security, compliance)

### Optional Fields
- **rule_config_id**: Configuration identifier (VARCHAR(10))
- **status**: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, TESTING (default: ACTIVE)
- **publishing_status**: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, PUBLISHED

### Required Claims
`editor`

- **400**: Invalid ID format (must be numeric)
- **404**: Rule not found

request.description:
Updates the publishing status of a rule with approval workflow.

### Path Parameters
- **ruleId**: Rule identifier

### Request Body
- **status**: New status (DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, PUBLISHED)

Manages rule approval workflow from draft to published state.
